request.purpose: Remove legacy lowercase gw_ table family from GOLD SQL2 only; preserve all uppercase GWXXX and IMC tables
statements: SET @drop_sql=(SELECT CONCAT('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ',GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT('`',TABLE_NAME,'`') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME SEPARATOR ',')) FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND BINARY TABLE_NAME LIKE 'gw\_%')

response.error: SQL kind SET is not allowed for migrations.
